summary.text: Star Billow Pillar is Seven Star Child's immortal killer move.

claims.text: Seven Star Child’s immortal zombie pushes with his left arm. A huge starlight pillar shoots from his hand without a sound. Immortal killer move Star Billow Pillar is named. The defense Hei Lou Lan raised is destroyed in the blink of an eye. Star billow pillar is a straight line attack. She dodges left and right and narrowly avoids it many times. Even when the light hits her, it is not for more than three breaths. After dozens of breaths the pillar vanishes. She cannot stay in that light for four breaths. During the retreat she is dancing on the edge of death.

Seven Star Child’s immortal zombie fires another star billow pillar at the rolling rock battlefield in the air. It is an immortal level star path killer move. The battlefield shakes and does not break.

Seven Star Child’s immortal zombie opens his left palm at Shi Lei’s head and names Star Billow Pillar again. The huge light pillar pierces the cloud layer, punches through a mountain peak, and brings down a wide collapse. Shi Lei endures the attack for fifteen breaths and still has some battle strength. His whole head is charred black, and his facial features are blurry, like melted wax. A later pillar hits him directly on the back and knocks him to the ground.
